headline: Sandvik Q3 Core Profit Jumps 53% While Order Intake Moderates
summary: Swedish engineering group Sandvik posted a 53% increase in third-quarter adjusted operating profit, though new order growth slowed as a prior boost from tungsten pricing waned.
why: Sandvik is a major supplier of mining, tooling, and industrial machining equipment, making its order book an indicator of industrial activity.

impacts.name: Sandvik AB
impacts.why: A 53% surge in core earnings was offset by softening order momentum as tungsten-driven gains subsided.
